notes.title: Week One update to prepare for Week-2
notes.content:
[h1]Preparation for Week Two[/h1]
Week Two is coming soon! We are in the last stages of making the game. There are some things still left to do, like passing Steam review and finishing all the translations. That is why it is hard to give you all the exact date, but we really hope that it will happen this month!
Meanwhile, there is some quality update for Week One adding a new save system, that will help you to transfer your progress from Week One to Week Two. Basically it won't ask you to save the game yourself, but will save it for you at the end of the story.

[h1]Portuguese added[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38274604/559e96d36617a4ca0f6f7850f15bef92d6e30a54.jpg[/img]
And we are happy to support the new language! Week Two will also be translated to Portuguese!

notes.title: Hear me roar!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 
Holiday season is about to start, and today I want to tell you about our update v1.0.28 where we added new voice effects to the game. We worked with voice actors to get unique impressions and give the game's story more life!

[b]Change Log v1.0.28:[/b]
[list]
[*] Almost every scene in the game got small voice impressions and highlights in the key moments.
[*] Almost every scene in the game got additional sound effects to make the surrounding feel better.
[*] Scene 04 on Day-1 has been updated with new animations.
[/list]

[b]Adding a remark here[/b] - The game isn't fully voiced. We wanted to add voice expressions where our characters just make expressive sounds in the important story moments. Unfortunately fully voicing the game isn't really possible now, for a game of our size. But I hope you would like the update that will give much better impression on our characters!

[b]Sad news[/b] - While preparing this update I found out that the game is banned now in Germany. That is not only affecting me, but also all the games on the market. Unfortunately there is no solution to this and we just lost a huge portion of our market.

[b]Known issues[/b]
One of the known issues in this update is that although we now have Voices in the game, you can't control the volume with the voice slider. For now the volume of voice effects are controlled with the "Sound Volume" slider. We already know about the issue and will fix it in the next update.
